run_elasticity_calculations: run the ElasticityRunner calculate method to compute elastic tensor and modulus for atomic structures
calculate_elastic_tensor: calculate the elastic tensor in GPa for a set of crystal structures using an ASE calculator
write_elasticity_results: write elasticity calculation results to a compressed JSON file using the write_results method
run_parallel_elasticity_jobs: run parallel elasticity calculations across multiple jobs using job_num and num_jobs parameters
convert_elastic_units: convert elastic tensor values from eV/Angstrom^3 to GPa using the eVA3_to_GPa conversion constant
